top_signals.title: Ryanair Initiates Cost Drive to Offset $2 Billion Jet-Fuel Surge
top_signals.summary: Ryanair Holdings Plc will embark on a cost purge across its airline to help offset a €2 billion ($2.2 billion) increase in fuel charges next year, as the Middle East conflict continues to drive up oil prices and weighs on consumer willingness to book flights.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oaktree's Marks on Long-term Investing
top_signals.summary: Howard Marks, Co-Chair at Oaktree Capital Management, says investors should build a portfolio of assets that can perform over the long term. He speaks exclusively on "The China Show". (Source: Bloomberg)

Tian Gan, CEO at ChinaAMC (HK), says the company aims to provide a transparent and liquid tokenization platform backed by a robust regulatory framework. He speaks exclusively on the sidelines of Hong Kong FinTech Week.

top_signals.title: Borderlands Mexico: Cabotage enforcements threatening cross-border trucking
top_signals.summary:
This week in Borderlands Mexico: Cabotage enforcements threatening cross-border trucking; Nuevo León slashes Colombia Bridge toll fees 50% to boost cross-border trucking; and Walmart plans $400M distribution center near San Antonio, creating 425 jobs.

top_signals.title: Euronext Joins Industry Push to Integrate Nordic Capital Markets
top_signals.summary: Stock exchange operator Euronext NV has joined the Nordic Compass alliance, a consortium of three dozen of Northern Europe’s largest companies advocating for closer regional ties.

top_signals.title: EU and Canada intensify cooperation in the area of medical countermeasures for preparedness and response to combat health emergencies
top_signals.summary: European Commission Joint press release Ottawa, 30 Oct 2026 On Monday 26 October, Hadja Lahbib, EU Commissioner for Preparedness and Crisis Management, and the Honourable Mélanie Joly, Minister of Industry and Minister responsible for Canada Economic Development for Quebec Regions, met to reaffirm the strong Canada-EU partnership on health emergency preparedness and response.
